rv.q: It is a theatrical experience I will not soon forget.
Round House Theatre's Ma Rainey's Black Bottom brings memory, survival, history, and a deeply human desire to be heard into intimate focus.
This revival succeeds because it never reduces those questions to a mere history lesson.
The magnificent performances reach toward something like salvation, without ever quite getting there.
The synergy between all of them has begotten an explosive, insightful, and ultimately chilling theatrical experience that sets the bar for this season's dramatic offerings impossibly high.
